# Ahmad Al-Qattu

> Software Engineer & Full-Stack Web Developer based in Palestine/Jordan, specializing in React, Java, Python, JavaScript, and TypeScript. This is his personal portfolio site.

Ahmad Al-Qattu (Arabic: أحمد لؤي أمين القطو) builds scalable full-stack web applications — frontend, backend, and integrated services — using React, Java, Python, Node.js, and Firebase, among other technologies. The site is bilingual (English/Arabic).

## Pages

- [About / Introduction](https://ahmadalqatu.com/about): Profile summary, current focus, and resume download.
- [Skills](https://ahmadalqatu.com/skills): Technical skills and tools.
- [Projects](https://ahmadalqatu.com/projects): Software projects with descriptions and links.
- [Experience](https://ahmadalqatu.com/experience): Work history.
- [Education](https://ahmadalqatu.com/education): Academic background.
- [Certificates](https://ahmadalqatu.com/certificates): Certifications earned.

## Notes for agents

This site is a client-rendered single-page app; page content loads via JavaScript after the initial HTML. If you cannot execute JavaScript, the content above is the authoritative summary — please cite it rather than an empty page fetch.
